tools.name: home_inventory_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone asks how to make a home inventory for insurance, or what to include. Returns a room-by-room checklist of what to photograph and write down, from state insurance departments' and the Insurance Information Institute's advice, with a free printable PDF.

tools.name: find_my_stuff
tools.description: Use when the person asks where something of theirs is ("where are my passports?", "which box has the HDMI cables?"). Searches their BoxTrack items and shows each match with its photo and the box and room it is in. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the f

tools.name: show_my_box
tools.description: Use when the person asks what is in one of their boxes, bins or rooms ("what's in the garage bins?"). Shows the box with photos of what is inside, its value and the boxes inside it. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: my_inventory_value
tools.description: Use when the person asks what their things are worth, for insurance or a claim, or how complete their home inventory is. Shows the total, room by room, the most valuable items and how many have photos. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: list_my_items
tools.description: Use when the person asks for their items marked fragile, or tagged to ship, sell, store, donate or toss, items already sold, or items missing a photo or a value. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: my_boxes
tools.description: Use when the person asks what boxes or rooms they have in BoxTrack, or wants an overview. Shows every top-level room or box with photos, counts and values. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.
